results.content:
AI Resume

# HiringNow Launches AI Agent to Bypass Job Boards and Target ATS Directly

linkCopy URL

Share

On October 30, a new platform called HiringNow entered the career tech space, introducing an automated tool designed to circumvent crowded job aggregators. This new AI job search agent directly scans over 247,000 employer career sites and applicant tracking systems to find fresh roles within minutes of them going live. By cutting out the standard reposting delay of third-party websites, the service aims to place candidates at the top of the applicant pile with highly customized submissions.

HiringNow Launches AI Agent to Bypass Job Boards and Target ATS Directly

## Direct System Monitoring [...] ## Direct System Monitoring

The software actively observes more than 65 major hiring platforms, including Greenhouse, Workday, and newer AI-first systems, refreshing its search every five minutes around the clock. Instead of relying on delayed syndicated feeds, it identifies matching opportunities based on user-defined rules such as salary constraints, preferred locations, and target roles. The platform processes approximately 50,000 fresh listings daily, matching them instantly against the user’s uploaded profile and experience metrics.

## User-Controlled Tailoring [...] ## User-Controlled Tailoring

Before initiating any submissions, the tool automatically drafts a unique resume aligned with the specific requirements of the open role. It pulls existing facts solely from the candidate’s verified history to ensure no synthetic or fabricated details are injected into the application. Every document remains in a holding pattern until the user manually reviews and approves the customized answers and formatted resume, ensuring human oversight for every outbound message.

## Tiered Application Workflows
